༄༅/ /gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don snying po'i ngag 'don gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don snying po'i ngag 'don gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro mgon rin po che/ /gnas lugs don rtogs chos rje rin po che/ /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpa' bos byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas nyams su blang rgyu'i chos ni 'di yin te/ brgyud pa la mos gus chug pa/ byin rlangs 'pho ba'i dbang skur thob nas/ 'khrid las kyi ngo bo la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ maṇḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bzhi las dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams chen po yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam dang sangs rgyas/ g.yas su dam chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lta ba spyod pa sgom pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rang sems stong pa chos sku gsum la skyabs sumachi'o/ khyed rnams la ni skyabs su mchi/ khyed rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge des sems can bde gyur cig /phaṭaḥ ces skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/

/mthar skyabs yul rnams 'od du nas rang la thim/ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / snyam pa gyis la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dung ba'i ngang nas/ ma rgan sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur rig /phaṭaḥ ces ngag nas brjod cing yid la bsam mo/ /gsum pa maṇḍal ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer med pa/ mdun du yi dam sogs skyabs yul bzhin gsal btab/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad kyi phyur bur bkang ste/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum kyi dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la phul bar mos la phaṭaḥ pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus/ /sgal tshigs ri rab lhun por gyur/ /yan lag nying lag gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /longs spyod rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dbus/ /mig ni nyi ma zla bas rab mdzes pa/ /nang khrol me tog snying ni yid bzhin nor/ / dgos 'dod ma lus char bzhin 'byung bas brgyan/ /phyi nang gsang gsum yon tan ci mchis pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yum chen 'khor bcas dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phaṭaḥ bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang*/ / dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog khyed la 'bul/ / thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/

/ zhes pa lan mang du brjod do/ /bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ phaṭaḥ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang sems can thams cad mnyam nyid du 'tshogs pa'i spyi bor rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ padma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi dbus su zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyis ḍa ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol ba/ stong gsum khyab pa'i sgras srid pa gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du bsdud par byed pa/ g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la brten zhing*/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi tshogs grol zhing sku rgyab gnon pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ sku smad la dar dmar po'i sham thabs gsol ba/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa dam tshig sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i rang bzhin sku mdog dmar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis kar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ zag med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ de ltar bla ma yab yum la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam gyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/

thams cad kyang gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug dang bcas ldan pa/ shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyar bas/ zag med chos sku'i rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa/ ma cig gi mdun gyi 'dab ma la/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo 'bum/ lho'i 'dab ma la rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo 'bum/ nub kyi 'dab ma la padma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'bum/ byang gi 'dab ma la las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo 'bum/ dbus phyogs su rdo rje'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo 'bum/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas cang te'u nam mkha' la 'khrol la/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung na kha ṭwāṃ ga gyen du bsgreng zhing 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ma cig ma'i spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng du pha gcig dam pa rgya gar sku mdog nag la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa shangs mtho la gug pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser du 'khyug pa/ tshems dkar la tshems rtse rno ba/ dbu skra zar bu gyen du brdzes shing*/ me tog gi phreng bas thod bcings pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi rkang gi gling bu kyu ru ru 'bud pa/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi gal ta thugs kar 'dzin pas/ sgrub pa po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dus stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ de la bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar seṅge sngon po rol pa'i khri'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ de la grub thob dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i spyi bor padma dngazla ba'i gdan gyi steng du sprul sku shākya thub pa la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/

de'i spyi bor pad zla nyi ma sum brtsegs kyi steng du yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dngul dkar gyi dril bu/ tha ma gnyis shes rab kyi po ti re re bsnams pa/ rin po che'i sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan cha/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal se mo do la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis sham thabs mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ba tsam du bzhugs par gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / zhes sogs/ bka' rgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /yi dam lha tshogs= /ma dang mkha' 'gro= /chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /mahā gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ phaṭaḥ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa dang*/ /phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang dgu rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /mahā gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabta 'i bar gyis mchod/ phaṭaḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms mdzad ma/ /lab sgron khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyis rlobs/

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /yum chen sher phyir byin rlabs can*/ /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo nas/ /bcom ldan shāka thub sogs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga ru/ /'jam dpal smra seng sogs/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod du/ /rdo rje phag mo sogs/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du/ /su kha siddhi sogs/ rgya gar 'jag ma'i spyil po ru/ /ārya de ba sogs/ la stod ding ri gling skor du/ /dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ ra sa spang lung dgon pa ru/ /bsod nams bla ma sogs/ zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon pa ru/ /ma gcig lab sgron byin sogs/ rgyal thang chu bzang dgon pa ru/ /bsam gtan 'od zer sogs/ byang chub gling gi dben gnas su/ /nam mkha' 'od zer sogs/ gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i gnas mchog tu/ /shākya 'od zer sogs/ phyogs med yangs pa'i ri khrod du/ /bde legs mtshan can sogs/ byin rlabs bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /dbon sras chos legs sogs/ kha rag bsam gling dgon pa ru/ /yig drug shes dpal sogs/ chos lung byang rtse'i dben gnas su/ /rje btsun grol mchog sogs/ brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang sogs/ chos lung bde mchog pho brang du/ /lung rig rgya mtsho sogs/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i spyi bo ru/ /kun dga' snying po sogs/ bdud rtsi phug gi dben gnas su/ /grags pa dpal bzang sogs/ 'bral med snying gi dkyil nang du/ /kun dga' rin chen sogs/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /dpal po mkha' 'gro byin sogs/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /chos skyong srung ma sogs/ dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su/ /rdo rje spun grogs byin rlabs can/

/byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par bdag sogs sems can thams cad bla ma la mos 'dun drag po'i gsol ba 'debs par bsam nas/ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pas byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin blo yi thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye med gcig chod du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bar chad dngos grub du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par by-in gyis rlobs/ /ma chos dbyings rnam dag shes rab pha rol phyin/ /yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i ma gcig ma/ /ma sku lus chung la gzi brjid che/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro/ /dbu skra mthon mthing thur du grol/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi cang te'u 'khrol/ /g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu bsil/ / rin chen rus rgyan khral la la/ /dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru/ /zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling ling 'khrab/ /phyag gdub zhabs gdub sil li li/ /ma chos dbyings rnam dag skye med dbyings kyi yum/ /'gags med rtsa bral sems nyid don gyi yum/ /mtha' dbus med pa mtha' bral stong pa'i yum/ /ma yum chen chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma 'gyur pa med pa rdo rje'i sku sprul ma/ / dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen sku sprul ma/ /gdod nas dag pa padma'i sku sprul ma/ /'phrin las grub pa las kyi sku sprul ma/ /ma yum chen sku lnga lhun grub ma/ / thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyi rlobs/ /thugs rjes dgongs la lam sna drongs/ /mkha' spyod gnas su drangs du gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma chos dbyings ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa shar du bskyod tsa na/ /don skye med ma bcos gdengs dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum/

/sku yi gar byed khyugs se khyugs/ /phyag gnyis ḍā dril khral la la/ / zhabs gnyis bro brdung khrabs se khrabs/ /phyag gdub zhabs gdub sil li li/ /dar gyi cod paṇa pur ru ru/ /rus pa'i rgyan cha khral la la/ /gsung gi nyams dbyangs 'ur ru ru/ /thugs kyi byin rlabs bungs se bungs/ /dngos grub char rgyun sil li li/ /phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sangs/ /pha ṭa ya la bar chad sol/ 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma mnyam nyid ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa lho ru bskyod tsa na/ / don yon tan rdzogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum/ / sogs rigs 'gre'o/ / ma sor rtogs ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa nub du bskyod rtsa na/ /don yon tan zag med nyams dang ldan/ /padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum/ / sogs/ ma bya grub ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa byang du bskyod tsa na/ /don lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu 'bum/ / sogs/ ma me long ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa dbus su bskyod tsa na/ /don 'gyur ba med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo 'bum/ /

sogs/ shar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ / dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa 'bum/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /shar phyogs dri za pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kun/ /byams pa tshad med lcags kyu yis/ /myur du bzung la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ lho rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ /ser mo zhags pa thogs pa 'bum/ /lho yi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /lho phyogs gshin rje pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kun/ /snying rje tshad med zhags pa yis/ /myur du chings la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ nub padma mkha' 'gro'i= /dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa 'bum/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /nub phyogs klu bdud pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre= /dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog gis/ myur du bsdoms la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i= ljang gu dril bu thogs pa 'bum/ /byang gi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /byang phyogs gnod spyin pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre= /btang snyoms tshad med dril bu yis/ /dbang du bsdus la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ dbus rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i= /sngon mo rdo rje thogs pa 'bum/ /steng gi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /steng phyogs lha gdon pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre= /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /dbang du bsdus la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ steng na lha tshogs bungs se bungs/ /g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas/ /g.yon na dpa' mo mdangs dang ldan/ /rgyab na ḍā ki'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mdun na dam can tshogs dang bcas/ /rol mo sna tshogs 'ur ru ru/ /glu len brda' skad kyu ru ru/ /gar stabs mang po khyugs se khyugs/ /rgyan cha mang po khral la la/ /byin rlabs sprin ltar bungs se bungs/ / dngos grub char rgyun sil li li/ /'og na snang srid nyil li li/ /gus pa'i brkyang phyag khral la la/ /gdung ba'i gsol 'debs 'ur ru ru/ /dad pa'i mchi ma phril li li/

/bla ma ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub bar du mchod pa 'bul/ /byang chub bar du sdig pa bshags/ / tshogs gnyis dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med chos 'khor bskor par bskul/ / 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ / ma lus gcig tu bsdus nas ni/ /mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyang*/ / yum chen go 'phang thob phyi bsngo/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' 'gro 'bum/ / byin gyis rlobs gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /lam sna drongs shig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /dag pa mkha' spyod bde chen du/ /dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ /rgyud bzhi smin par= /sku bzhi thob par= /phaṭa/ bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar= /'chi ba rjes su dran par= /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar= /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par= /gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyid sdug ro snyams nus par= /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar= /ltas ngan g.yangs su len par= /na tsha bogs su thon par= / 'gyel lan lam du longs bar= /lha 'dre'i 'dren ston nus par= /byams dang snying rje 'byongs par= /'gro don mtha' ru phyin par= /tshe 'di nyid la byin= / gnas mchog 'di ru= /'dug sa 'di ru= /da lta nyid du= /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /phaṭa/ de nas dbang bzhi len thabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ mtshan ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la mngon par dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ / zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung*/ rang gi dpral bar zhugs/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sprul sku'i go 'phang thob/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung*/ rang gi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/

gsung rdo rje'i= longs sku'i= thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer mthing ka gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung*/ rang gi snying gar zhugs/ yid gyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs rdo rje'i= chos sku'i= yang lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum las 'od zer kha dog lnga cig car du byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang thob/ lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dpral bar padma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying gar padma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po la shes pa gtad la bgrang nas thun mtshams su/ oṃ bla ma'i sku gsol ba 'debs/ /sku yi nyams chags mthol lo bshags/ /lus la sku'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /āḥbla ma'i gsung la gsol ba= gsung gi nyams chags= ngag la gsung gis= longs sku thob par= hūṃ bla ma'i thugs la= thugs kyi nyams chags= sems la thugs kyis= chos sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ / mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe snying pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'od kha dog sna lnga'i dbus su bla ma'i sku tshon gang ba gcig tu bsam/ snying dbus a wa dhā tī'i gzhal yas su/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /sku lnga lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / de'i thugs kar hūṃ la shes pa gtad la gnyid log par bya'o/ /sngon 'gro bzhi po 'di zhag bdun nam zla phyed la sogs pa la bskyangs/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yum don ngo sprod pa dang bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa gnyis so/

/dang po la sems 'dzin gyi gdams ngag dang*/ ngo sprod gnyis so/ /dang po gnyis ka 'khrid yig gzhung na gsal/ gnyis pa bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ phaṭaḥ rgyu 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /dug gsum rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon gsum/ /gdon gsum rang sar dag par byin gyi rlobs/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bzhi/ /nad bzhi rang sar dag par= /thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ /bdud bzhi rang sar dag par= /lha 'dre yid kyi cho 'phrul la/ /rang snang 'chun par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dre rtog 'dre 'dzin 'dre 'byung gsum/ /byung yang rang gi sems las byung*/ /thim yang rang gi sems la thim/ /yal yang chos nyid ngang nas yal/ /phaṭa/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings nas byin gyis rlobs/ /rdzogs ba chen po'i dbyings nas= /dbu ma chen po'idabyings nas= /gsal stong chen po'i= /rig stong chen po'i= /snang stong chen po'i= / gsal rig stong gsum dbyings nas= /thabs shes zung 'jug dbyings nas= / sems can thams cad don du= /bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phan pa legs na phan par= /shi ba legs na shi bar= /gson pa legs na gson par= /sdug pa legs na sdug par= /skyid pa legs na skyid par= /bdag bde gzhan la btad bar= /gzhan sdug rang la len pa= /dbang bzhi rgyud la skye bar= /rgyud bzhi sems la smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phaṭaḥ dbyings rig bsre ba khrid gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /'di yan chad la rang stobs kyi nyams len rkang tshugs pa'i myong ba med par gnyan khrod 'grims pa stong sob yin/ sgom gyi rkang 'di yan chad la tshugs dgos/ gnyan khrod 'grims pa bogs 'don dang 'gro ba'i don yin pas/ de bzhin go dgos so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa la/ zhi gcod dang*/ drag gcod dang*/

zhi drag phyed ma'i gcod dang gsum las/ dang po zhi gcod dkar 'gyed ni/ phaṭa/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo tshon gang ba tsam snying gar gnas pas de spyi gtsug rgya skar kha phye ba lta bu'i nang nas yar thon mdun du 'khod par gyur/ phaṭa/ de'i mdun du thod sgyed nag po ri rab tsam gsum du gyur/ phaṭa/ rje btsun ma'i gri gug gis rang gi ro de'i smin mtshams yan chad har gyis bkog nas/ sgyed po gsum gyi khar phog pas/ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ stong gsum gyi rgya dang mnyam par gyur/ phaṭa/ rje btsun mas rang gi ro de ma ning nas brang mdo'i bar du shags kyis bkas nas/ snying rbad kyis bcad pas thod pa'i nang du bzhag pas gtor ma'i sdong po ri rab tsam du gyur/ phaṭa glo ba/ stol kha/ mchin pa/ mtsher pa/ mkhal ma nang khrol lnga po dmar nyil gyis byung nas gtor sha ri phran tsam du gyur/ phaṭa/ glad pa dang sgal glad gangs ri tsam du gyur nas gtor rgyan/ phaṭa/khrag dang chu ser dmar hril gyis byang nas rakta'i rgya mtsho dang mchod yon gyi chur gyur*/ phaṭa/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i nang bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ de thams cad la mchod pas de rnams tshim zhing dgyes/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin pas/ gnas skabs su tshim zhing*/ mthar thug sdig sgrib thams cad byang*/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma gtor bas/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byung*/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par bsam/ de thams cad rang sems su shes pas/ phaṭa/ oṃ khams gsum ma lus zhing khams nas/ /sku gsum 'khor 'das thugs rje'i mgron/

/stong gsum bdud rtsi'i khengs pa'i rdzas/ /gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ru bsngo/ / zhes pa'i rjes su gtor gzhong la bya ba ni/ oṃ phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /nang bcud sems can gtor mas bkang*/ /skye 'chi med par mchod pa bzhes/ /phyi nam mkha' yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /nang 'byung ba bzhi'i gtor mas= /rang gsal rang dag mchod= /bka' pha rol phyin pa'i= / sa bcu dag pa'i gtor mas/ /myang 'das chen por= /bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i gtor mas= /theg pa brgyad kyi= /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs= /kun gzhi yangs pa'i gtor= /rnam shes tshogs brgyad gtor mas= /'phel 'grib med par= /rang sems gnyug ma'i gtor= /lus ngag yid gsum gtor mas bkang*/ /brjod du med par= /skye ba med pa'i= /rig pa byung tshor gtor mas= /'gyu ba rang grol= /chos sku dag pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis gtor mas= /thugs rjes 'gro don mchod par bzhes/ /stong pa nyid kyi gtor gzhong du/ /snang ba dkar dmar= /snang med chen por= /rang rgyud dag pa'i= /gnyis med dag pa'i gtor mas bkang*/ /ngos bzung med par= /chos nyid dag pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /sems bde gsal chen po'i gtor mas bkang*/ /ngos bzung bral bar= /rang lus rgyal ba'i= /rang sems skye med gtor mas bkang*/ /re dogs med par= /ka pā la yi= /sha khrag rus gsum gtor mas bkang*/ /mchod sbyin chen pos= /rin chen snod kyi= /dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor mas bkang*/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad la/ /bsngos pa bzhin du tshim gyur cig /bsam pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /re ba bzhin du skangs gyur cig /yum chen phar phyin man chad nas/ /yi dam lha tshogs= rigs 'gre/ shākya thub pa man chad nas/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad yan chad la/ / sogs/ kun tu bzang po man chad nas/ /'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad la/ / sogs/

sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro man chad nas/ /sha za mkha' 'gro yan chad la/ / sogs/ chos skyong srung ma man chad nas/ /lha srin sde brgyad yan chad la/ / sogs/ dpal ldan lha mo man chad nas/ /grong rgyug 'dre mo yan chad la/ / sogs/ dam can mgar ba=/ the brang pho mo= sogs/ tshangs pa brgya byi= nam mkha'i lha bran yan chad la/ sogs/ klu rgyal mtha' yas= /gdol rigs klu bran= sogs/ byi na ya ka= /sa 'og 'byung bo= sogs/ gdon chen bco brgyad man= lus gdon pho mo= sogs/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dma' na rag dmyal khams yan chad la/ sogs/ bar snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la/ /tshad med gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /rgyal ba mchod pas gnyes gyur cig / dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pas tshim gyur cig / bu lon lan chags byang gyur cig /mchog gi dngos grub thob gyur cig /phaṭa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la/ /skam sar thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgyu lus gzugs kyi phung po la/ /bdag 'dzin bral bar= snang ba sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /bden med rtogs bar= /na tsha dge sbyor gyi bogs 'don la/ /lam du khyer bar byin= /lha 'dre sems kyi 'cho 'phrul la/ /re dogs bral bar= / skyid sdug sngon gyi las 'bras la/ /ro snyoms nus par= /'dod yon thar pa'i bar chod la/ /zhen pa log par= /'gro kun pha ma'i rang bzhin la/ /gnod sems zhi bar= /sku 'gyur ba med par= /gsung 'gag pa med par= /thugs 'khrul pa med par= /lus shags ma shigs mar= /sems khral ma khrol mar= / nyams 'ar ma 'ur mar byin gyis rlobs/ /phaṭa/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la gtor bas gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de 'od du zhu nas nang bcud kyi lha tshogs rnams la thim/ lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dbyings rig bsre/ gnyis pa drag gcod dmar 'gyed ni/

thog mar rang gi gnas snying du thun gyi nyams len zhi gcod dang 'dra ba las thun gyi mthar dmar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa re bya/ de la dmar 'gyed ni/ rang sems sngar bzhin phyir bton la/ rang lus de stong gsum khyab pa'i mi ro tsho bcud snum bag dang ldan ba gcig tu gyur/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha srin sde brgyad thams cad la 'bod pa'i skad btang bas/ thams cad skad cig la 'dus te/ sa dang nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bsam/ de nas rang lus dum bur dum bur gtubs/ khyad cag ci 'dod zos/ gang 'dod pa longs/ zhes brjod/ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo 'brug gi mgo can 'brug gi ngar skad dang ldan pas stong gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad klad pa bkas pa bzhin zhabs su btsud/ zhal nas thog dang ser ba 'bab pa/ sku la 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo bkra ba/ phyag g.yas pas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i skyog chen po brdab cing*/ g.yon pas mi rkang gi gling bu tshag dir ri ri 'bud pas/ srid pa gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad ra phag ser bas ded pa bzhin 'dir 'dus par bsam/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ na mo gnyan sa 'dir gnas kyi lha 'dre dang*/ /skal ldan bdag la cho 'phrul ston mdzad pa'i/ /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre ma lus kun/ /nam mkha'i sprin tshogs bzhin du 'dus la shog /bar snang char pa bzhin du 'phob la shog / sa gzhi rlung dmar bzhin du 'tshubs la shog /phaṭa/ sems 'gyu ba dngos med stong pa 'di/ /'dre khyod bas ngas kyang mthong ba med/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad dgrar langs kyang*/ /'jigs so snyams na rang la sdig /nga stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'khrul pa'i mtshan ma chod pa'i phyir/ /'dre khyod la nyams nga rdul tsam med/ /lar thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /med bzhin du snang ba ngo mtshar che/ khyed cag 'jig rten lha ma srin/ /skye 'gro'i tshe srog nyul ma rnams/

/nga sgyu ma'i gzugs kyi phung po 'di/ /mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /cis kyang mi sdod 'dor ba la/ /'dre khyod la dgos na gang dgos khyer/ /phaṭa/ khog stod ya bdud rgyal pos khyer/ /ya bdud rgyal po tshim gyur cig khog smad ma bdud rgyal mos khyer/ /ma bdud rgyal mo tshim gyur cig /rked pa klu bdud the brang khyer/ /klu bdud the brang tshim gyur cig /yan lag gnyan chen sde bzhis khyer/ /gnyan chen sde bzhi tshim gyur cig /glo snying pe har rgyal pos khyer/ /pe har rgyal po tshim gyur cig /rgyu ma yul 'dre 'khyams pos khyer/ /yul 'dre 'khyams po= /phyi sha phyi yi lha 'dres khyer/ /phyi yi lha 'dre= /bar sha bar gyi lha 'dres khyer/ /bar gyi lha 'dre= /nang sha nang gi lha 'dres khyer/ /nang gi lha 'dre= /sha la dgyes pa sha la rol/ /sha za'i 'chag sgra dir ri ri/ khrag la dgyes pa khrag la rol/ khrag 'thung hub sgra di ri ri/ /rus la dgyes pa rus la rol/ /rkang brdung lhab pa chibs se chibs/ /seṅge sha la rol pa bzhin/ /phud lhag med pa bzhes su gsol/ /ya gi spyi gtsug man chad nas/ /ma gi rkang mthil yan chad la/ /lhu tshigs bcu gnyis mgo bo dang*/ /klad pa klad rgyas gzi mdangs bkrag /nang khrol rnam lnga khu khrag zhag /dbugs dang tshe srog ba spu skra/ /rkang dang tshil bu sen mo so/ /pags pa dri ma thams cad 'bul/ /spyir khams gsum sems can glud du 'bul/ /dgos rdo rje slob dpon glud du 'bul/ /chos mdzad rdo rje spun gyi glud du 'bul/ khyad par drin can pha ma'i glud du 'bul/ /lus sha khrag gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ khyed dga' mgu rangs zhing tshim gyur cig /sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi/ /bu lon 'brel thag chod gyur cig /phaṭa/

ces brjod pas/ so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par sha khrag rus pa/ nang khrol yan lag sogs zos 'thung khyer bas/ gnas skabs su tshim zhing*/ mthar thug nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ slar de thams cad rang gnas su song bar bsgom/ de nas de yang rang sems su shes bzhin pas/ phaṭa/ ces dbyings rig bsre la ba zhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom/ gsum pa zhi drag phyed ma ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ dkar 'gyed dang dmar 'gyed gnyis ka bsgom/ de yang sngon 'gro chos bzhi/ snga thun gnyis la zhi gcod lta bu dang*/ phyi thun gnyis la drag gcod lta bu bsgom/ mthar drag gcod ltar stong nyid kho na bsgom pa thun re bzhin bya/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lhongs tshad dang mchog thun mong gi tshan tshad la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas par khrid yig dang man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /snying rje sgom pa/ bshags pa dang*/ slon lam dang*/ tshogs mchod dang*/ gtor ma rnams gal che'o/ /bshags pa ni/ oṃ bde legs mchog gi rnyed thabs te/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yin par ma shes nas/ /dngos grub gzhan du btsal ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /rang sems rtsa ba chad pa de/ /chos sku yin par ma shes nas/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du btsal ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo gshags/ /gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /skyabs gnas yin par ma shes nas/ /mos gus 'bul stobs chung ba de/ /ma sprul ba'i= /brtse gdung 'dres pa'i mched grogs de/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin par ma shes nas/ /nyams pa'i khong khro shor ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i= /tshul khrims rnam dag dri med de/ /thar lam yin par ma shes nas/ /'chal ba'i mngon lkog shor ba de/ /ma sprul ba'i= /'jig rten zhen pa che ba de/ /ltas ngan yin par ma shes nas/ /rtag tu re ba byed pa de/ /ma sprul pa'i= khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /pha ma yin par ma shes nas/ /sems can gzhan gnod byed pa de/

/ma sprul pa'i= /man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul de/ /snod ngan yin par ma shes nas/ / rgyal khams yongs la spel ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i= /chags med sbyin pa btang ba de/ /tshogs gnyis yin par ma shes nas/ /rang lus gces 'dzin byed pa de/ /ma sprul ba'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /mthol lo gshags so ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnong ngo 'gyod do dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ na mo bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum du/ /dge ba 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de bzhin zag bcas zag pa med/ /de dag la ni yi rang ngo*/ /yi rang byang chub chen por bsngo/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /bar chad med par 'jug par shog /bar chad med par 'jug nas kyang*/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong par/ /stong nyid dam pa'i don rtogs shog /phaṭa/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas/ /lam bgrod byang chub mchog thob nas/ /bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /skye ba med la gzugs sku 'char/ /'gro rnams bde la 'god mdzad pas/ /yum chen pha rol phyin ma yis/ /bkra shis des kyang = tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhis/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rab mchod pas/ /nyin mtshan kun du bsrung byed pa/ /bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gcod yul kun kyi snying po'i don/ /gang de sgrub thabs 'di yin pas/ /nyams len gyis shig skal ldan bu/ /tsob tsob blo sna ma mang zhig khrid yig gnad don snying po'i zhabs tog tu dmigs nas/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun ngag 'don 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu grags pa dpal bzang gis bsdebs te bris pa'o// //skal med la gsang ba gal che/ rgya rgya rgya/ ma ṅga laṃ/ /dge'o/ /'di bris dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bdag 'dzin dbyings su chod cing bdag med rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/bkra shis/ / ༈ gsol 'debs dgongs bskyod ma ni/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sku/ /ma cig jo mo rnal 'byor ma/ /skal ldan rnams kyi rgyud khrol ma/ /pha rol phyin ma'i grub thob ma/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yi dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /ma cig jo mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub lam sgron la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma skye ba dman la dgongs pa mtho/ /sku lus chung la gzi mdangs che/ /sku sha dkar la 'od zer 'phros/ /kun dang mthun pa'i spyod pa can/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ ma ser sna med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /kun khyab sbyin pa blo gtong ba'i*/ /rang byung ye shes don rtogs pa'i/ /nyams pa med pa'i khrims bsrung ma/ /ma bdag gzhan med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /ma skye med bzod pa bsgom tsa na/ /ma gzhi rtsa med pa'i don rtogs pas/ /'bad med brtson 'grus brtsom mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ ma g.yeng ba med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /g.yengs med bsam gtan sgom mdzad ma/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i/ /bdag med shes rab sgom mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ ma phyogs med lta bu'i zhen pa khrol/ /mnyam nyid sgom pa'i dmigs gtad grol/ /rtogs med spyod pa'i nyam nga grol/ /dmigs med 'bras bus re dogs grol/ /gti mug med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /rnam mkhyen thugs la mnga' mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ ma mnyam nyid ngang la bzhugs tsa na/ /don mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /dug lnga spang pa'i ye shes kyi/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor// nyams dbyangs mgur ma khrol lo lo/ /gdam ngag sbrang char si li li/ /byin rlabs na bun thu lu lu/ /g.yas na dpa' bo sha ra ra/ /g.yon na dpa' mo thibs se thibs/ /mi rkang gling bu kyu ru ru/ /tshul chen dud pa chi li li/ /hūṃ gi gdam pa sha ra ra/ /phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra di ri ri/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/

/ma yi dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /ma cig jo mo la gsol ba 'debs// byang chub lam sgron la= /ye shes mkha' 'gro la= /ma mnyam nyid ngang la bzhugs tsa na/ /don rjes thob gsal ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor/ /nyams dbyangs= sogs bgres sa ོ/ / ma dgongs pa shar du bskyod tsa na/ /don skye ba med pa'i don dang ldan/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs= sogs/ ma dgongs pa lho ru skyod tsa na/ /don yon tan rdzogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs= sogs/ ma dgongs pa nub tu bskyod tsa na/ /don skyon rnams dag pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs= sogs/ ma dgongs pa byang du bskyod tsa na/ /don 'gags pa med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ / las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs= sogs/ ma dgongs pa dbus su bskyod tsa na/ /don mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rig pa dbyings su pu ru ru/ /rig med lta ba phya la la/ /mnyam nyid dgongs pa phri li li/ /mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs thibs se thibs/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ de ltar gsol 'debs dgongs bskyod ma 'di ni slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs gtor dbang gi mgor 'don dgos lags/ dbang gi mgor mi dgos lags/ sgra bsgyur smra ba'i phyag tu phul/ bran pa blos tshul nas so/ /maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ /mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 330 -- PAGE 331 -- PAGE 309 -
